---
title: "Setup"
subtitle: "Before the first session (23/11)"
---

If something fails, email me the error **before** the first session. Still stuck on day 1? Use R in the browser, <https://webr.sh> (no login), and finish the setup before session 2.

## 1. R 4.5 or later

<https://cran.r-project.org>. Check an existing installation with `R.version.string`.

## 2. RStudio

<https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/> (or [Positron](https://positron.posit.co)). Quarto is included.

## 3. Packages

In the RStudio **console**:

```r
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "here", "janitor", "patchwork", "broom",
          "rmarkdown")
install.packages(setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages())))
```

## 4. Course project

*File > New Project > New Directory > New Project*, name it `s4ns-A`. From now on, **always open it with `s4ns-A.Rproj`**.

In the *Files* pane, create a folder `data` inside the project.

Each session: read the exercises on the [schedule](index.qmd), download the datasets linked at the top into `data`, answer in a new Quarto document (*File > New File > Quarto Document*) saved in the project.

## 5. Check

In the console. It should print `All good!`:

```r
stopifnot(getRversion() >= "4.5.0")
for (p in c("tidyverse", "here", "janitor", "patchwork", "broom", "rmarkdown"))
  stopifnot(requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE))
stopifnot(dir.exists(here::here("data")))
cat("All good!\n")
```

Then create a new Quarto document and click **Render**.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Optional: Git and GitHub
Not required here, but very useful for your PhD: see [Happy Git with R](https://happygitwithr.com), ch. 4–12.
:::
